items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Rudy Dooley is made by the Interviewer describing Chris's habits.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Can you remember any stories or anecdotes or anything about Chris, you know, like any incidents or anything at all that would just be of some interest to, you know, colorful or something to remember? Like what? Like where he used to go? Yeah, like where he used to go or?

He used to go to Rudy Dooley's and drink wine all the time. Where's that? Used to call him Rudy Dooley. There's a man by the name of Rudy Dooley. What? He used to have a speakeasy and go in there and drink wine. Where was that? That was on St. Anne Street. St. Anne's General. Oh, my God.
Who were some of his friends that you come up with?
